svg.text: One HTTP request, top to bottom. Every request is short-lived: DB connections, sessions and output buffers end with it.
page script builds the component tree:
submit value == form name ? else skip
prefer the driver inside a transaction
first responder whose accept() is true
PageCache hit & TTL ok → echo, skip
<head> flushed before the body is built:
browser fetches CSS / JS in parallel
sparkbox core (lib/) → sparkstore (lib/store, module 'store/') → site (class/, config/)
generated for the SparkBox README — edit freely in Inkscape
